Name key used by the guards

Source: R/md-observed-guards.R
md_guard_key.Rd

npmatch's exact-lookup key, npmatch::np_name_core(): upper case, accents removed, & to AND, apostrophes and initialism periods deleted (ST MARY'S = SAINT MARYS), other punctuation to spaces, abbreviations expanded, then connector words and legal forms dropped.

Usage

md_guard_key(x)

Arguments

x

Names.

Value

Character keys, "" for NA.
